provenance.adql: SELECT TOP 5001 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,ref_epoch,phot_variable_flag,duplicated_source,bp_rp,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag,ra_error,dec_error,pmra_error,pmdec_error,parallax,parallax_error FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',269.4463051973687,4.767723693726218,0.2)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<=19.0 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

magnitude_selection.status: Explicit sample selection, not catalog completeness guarantee

provenance.variability_policy: Exclude VARIABLE; unknown variability does not prove constancy.
provenance.quality_policy: Exclude duplicates/missing required astrometry/color/photometry. RUWE preserved without invented cutoff.
limitations: Catalog sources are candidate references only.
No image blending/saturation or infrared variability screen is established by Gaia alone.
Neighbors fainter than the explicit Gaia G magnitude selection are not represented.
